svg.text: an outbox that remembers: real email out, signals in, memory with sources, a model that only ever proposes
Hot paths — deterministic, no model, ever
pixel hit → fingerprint rules → verdict → Signal (image always returned)
click redirect → Signal → 302 · send → pixel + link rewrite → dispatch
import boundary — ai/ never imports the send path; a test fails the build if crossed
ai/ — everything that touches a model
runAgent — the one wrapper: budget check → context receipt →
schema → cited-id verification → run log (with the exact prompt)
extractor → proposals · brief (cites ids) · draft (never sent by itself)
inbox classify tiers: header rules → embeddings/cheap LLM → local
investigator (bounded tools) · replay & drift · trust policy · evals
inbox sync, digest, nightly jobs, drift
your own OAuth token, or the org's own
webhooks out — signed envelopes, delivery log
pixel · click · reply (via public BASE_URL — a tunnel in dev)
send → Signal(sent) → their client opens → classifier verdict (human/automated) → Signal(open) → engagement + follow-through recompute (no model)
they reply → matched by thread / Message-ID → Signal(reply) → category policy (never / ask / auto) → extractor reads it as untrusted text
→ PROPOSAL with a verbatim quote → you accept → active memory with a source → the brief cites it → next week's draft carries a receipt

g.text: if a rule or query can decide it,
the model proposes; a person decides —
every output is a Proposal, every
human choice a Label; autonomy is
other people's text is data, not
and webhooks reach a model only in
degrade and are recorded on the run,
never fatal; keys encrypted at rest
scan is stored and labelled, never
counted as an open; the residual
every model call leaves a receipt —
what it saw, what was dropped, cost;
prompts or models, diffed as drift
